name: overtone
description: Self-hostable music streaming with pluggable sources

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server && npm run build -w @overtone/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @overtone/web && npm run e2e -w @overtone/web
